text.text:
payment-service is experiencing concurrent DB_TIMEOUT, OOM_KILL, and DEPLOY_FAILURE conditions: PostgreSQL on postgres-primary is near pool exhaustion with `FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections`, the payment pod is CrashLoopBackOff with `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` and `OOMKilled`, and the v2.8.4 deployment has only 1/6 replicas available.  
Affected services are payment-service, postgres-primary, api-gateway, kubelet/kubernetes, and secondarily auth-service and redis-cache due to separate 401s from Redis session lookup timeouts.  
Overall severity is P1, with immediate user impact on payment submissions and some authenticated requests: api-gateway is returning 504s/502s on `POST /api/v1/payments` and 401s on `/api/v1/profile`, causing failed or delayed transactions and login/session failures.  
The single most critical next step is to roll back payment-service from v2.8.4 to v2.8.3 immediately to restore availability while the DB and OOM issues are triaged.

*Issues Identified:*
• *DB_TIMEOUT* on `payment-service, postgres-primary, api-gateway` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *OOM_KILL* on `payment-service, kubelet, kubernetes` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *NETWORK_ERROR* on `api-gateway, payment-service` — P1 (confidence: 94%)
• *AUTH_ERROR* on `auth-service, redis-cache, api-gateway` — P1 (confidence: 95%)
• *DB_TIMEOUT* on `postgres-primary, payment-service` — P1 (confidence: 89%)
• *DEPLOY_FAILURE* on `deployment-controller, payment-service, kubernetes` — P2 (confidence: 88%)
